pullRequests.title: fix: enemy copies, party host takeover and edge cases in Difficulty
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/enemy-count-copies
pullRequests.body:
Before: with Enemy count above 1, copies of path and cover enemies (Novalis birdbots, troopers, saw bots) stood on top of each other: they hid each other, caught each other's shots and split apart once hit. Spawned and big enemies could still overlap. When a party's host left, the new host ran no Chaos events or enemy copies, and an event on at that moment never ended.
After:

Birdbots, mine layers and minibombers are no longer copied (their init puts them at their path's start).
Copies keep…

Keep one canonical NPC reward per source in both Item Randomizer and Archipelago. Route the spawned infobot through that same reward and persistent collection state, preserving the NPC's network ID and save bit. Collecting either path spends the check for both; the other path…

pullRequests.title: fix(rac1): prevent empty vendor reopening and unsafe previews in both mods
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/rac1-empty-vendor-reopen
pullRequests.body:
After buying the final randomized reward, a physical vendor could reopen with no purchasable entries. The existing direct-open guard only covered the Gadgetron PDA; physical vendors relied on a per-frame interaction guard. An empty or consumed selection could then reach retail preview initialization, matching the reported Eudora crash after buying Grindboots.
In both Item Randomizer and Archipelago, validate filtered stock at every vendor-open call. Physical vendors accept unchecked reward rows…

commits.headline: fix(ng-plus-plus): small bursts keep a place for platinum, 0.3.5
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Under the game's coin limit the split filled places strictly by worth, so a
2,000-bolt drop in a 2-coin burst took a gold 1,000 and a gold 500 and paid no
platinum at all; the platinum part went to the game's pending credit. Gold now
leaves the last place free until platinum has a coin.

commits.headline: fix(ng-plus-plus): name the tier in the game's popup after an in-hand level-up
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A tier earned with the weapon in hand plays the game's own level-up
animation, and at its end the game shows the popup of its level-up table
(help_show_message_for_id, func_00288508). That line names the last
version ("Ultra ..."), and for a weapon the table has no line for (the
RYNO II, the Zodiac) the game shows text 0: an empty box.

The mod now waits for that popup after starting the animation (ten
seconds at most) and names it: the tier's name in place of the
version's in the table's line,…

commits.author: Veradictus

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): enemies get tougher half as fast again each new game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The enemies' curve from the second challenge mode grows 1.5 times as
fast as 0.3's: health x2.5, x4, x5.5, x6, x6.5, then a quarter more a
game up to x6.75; the damage they deal x1.375, x1.75, x2.125, x2.5,
x2.875, then +0.375 a game up to x4.

The tiers still keep the player ahead: a weapon at the tier expected by
then kills faster than V4 did in the first challenge mode (Delta 1.2
times, Zeta 1.125, Omega 1.27), and the health stops under Omega's x7,
so a fully upgraded weapon of every kind…

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): Tabora's crystals and Grelbin's moonstones pay more each new game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The two collectors pay the run scale times the game's price from the
second challenge mode (x1.5, x2.5, x4, x6; generous half as much again,

Neither has a hook point: their dialogs (texts 10135 and 10209) show the
scaled total in place of the game's, and a trade, seen at the next tick
as the count down to 0 with the game's pay in the bolts in the same
level, gets the rest of the scaled pay added. A count that drops without

commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
* fix(difficulty): do not copy birdbots and mine layers

Their update moves them to their path's first point, so a copy sat inside
the original. On Novalis the pair hid each other and the original's shots
were blocked by its copy.

Copies whose AI walks to the same path or cover point as the original
ended up inside it, hiding it and blocking its shots. A copy now spawns
2 units from the other copies, and is moved apart a little…

commits.headline: fix(ng-plus-plus): each enemy pays its own drop, past the game's three-coin limit
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: The game caps a kill at three coins and puts the rest in its word divided by the streak, so at long streaks every scaled drop came out as the same three 1,000s. From the second challenge mode the burst runs without that limit, the whole total is made again as coins within the game's limit plus two per x1 of toughness, and what they can't hold is added to the bolts at once. Toughness (the enemy's own bolts at +0xB4) now goes up to x6 (720 bolts) instead of x2, so a drop grows as the enemy's…

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): race and arena prizes and sellers' prices follow the run scale
commits.author: Veradictus

From the second challenge mode the hoverbike races of Barlow and Joba and
the arena challenges of Maktar and Joba pay the run scale (x1.5, x2.5,

seller, Aranos prison's seller, Smolg's machine and the gadget sellers.

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): weapons' shots, bots and effects glow in their tier's color
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Each tick the level's moby table is looked through for the weapons' own
classes (guns, shots, bombs, blasts, bots, turrets and the Shield
Charger's shield); a moby whose weapon wears a tier is drawn with
OpenRAC's energy material (interface 1.25) in the tier's color at the
tier's strength: a touch of the color on the body with a glowing rim,
and its glow, sparks, arcs and trails in the color, brighter and larger
with each tier. Omega cycles the rainbow, Heavy RYNO II glows orange and
Ultima…

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): enemies outgrow the tiers, bosses hold out, the RYNO II has its own rule
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: Enemy health goes x3.75, x6, x9, x9.75, x10.25, then up to x10.5: the tier a player can have by then needs a quarter to a half more hits than V4 in the first challenge mode, Omega included. Bosses (by class) have x2 to x3 more on top, the final boss half as much again. The RYNO II is left out of the curve: ordinary enemies take its hits as the game made them, tough ones (110 bolts or more) two to twelve times the game's RYNO II's hits, bosses three to seven, the final boss 4.5 to 10.5.

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): kills give more weapon experience each new game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body: From the second challenge mode a kill's weapon experience (Moby_RecordDeath: every weapon's gain from the game's award) goes x1.5, x2.5, x3.5 and x4.5, times the fourth root of a bigger enemy's bolts over 20 (at most x2.45), a boss's x5 or the final boss's x10, so a tier takes about as long to level by experience as Beta did in the first challenge mode despite the extra hits.

commits.headline: feat(ng-plus-plus): extra enemies each new game
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
From the second challenge mode every enemy a level places gets a copy
beside it as the level loads, two from the fourth. OpenRAC makes them
(interface 1.25, moby_copy_check and moby_copy, read from the table
past the SDK's as bolt_api.h does): never a boss, turret, spawner,
Tabora's or Grelbin's crystal creature, nor an enemy the level's waves,
arenas, doors or scripts count. A copy drops its enemy's bolts through
the game's own drop (the run's scale, platinum and obsidian apply) and
counts for…
